title: TravelConnect
description: A microservices-based travel itinerary coordinator that consolidates booking details, parses real-time flight notifications, and automates calendar updates.

title: Data Story Analyzer
description: Data Story Analyzer (BYOK) is a privacy-first web app for client-side data profiling, dynamic visualizations, and AI-driven insights using personal LLM API keys .By computing statistical summaries and correlations entirely in the browser, it sends only aggregated JSON metadata to LLMs—ensuring raw data privacy while eliminating AI hallucinations.

description: Research into running local LLMs via Ollama and LM Studio, including GPU sizing for local inference.
